# Pacific Rim Institute of Marine Artists
## Jubilee Art Exhibition
### A Nautical Celebration

(PRIMA Pacific Rim Institute Marine Artists logo)

### Exhibit Description
The Pacific Rim Institute of Marine Artists (PRIMA) was founded in 2016 by Austin Dwyer and Bob Bryant to bring together maritime artists living on or near the Pacific Rim. Over the last ten years the group has grown, holding live and online shows along the West Coast.

This is PRIMA's third exhibition at The Center for Wooden Boats. PRIMA President Buck Braden called it "a great honor" to be selected for CWB's 50th Anniversary.

The show is not juried and carries no prizes; it encourages members to exhibit their best marine work. 17 artists from the West Coast and Hawaii are showing 38 pieces, most of which are for sale.
